title: Decision
description: Decision Agent final output. §57-63, §99.4. RECONSTRUCTED from the architecture doc — diff against the actual locked Decision.json before use.

generated_at.description: Added for consistency with RouteResult/TrendResult/ReportContent and for decisions-collection sorting — not explicitly named in §58 but implied by every other final-stage object having one.

one_line_recommendation.description: Concise dashboard recommendation, short enough for SMS/push. §58.2

key_findings.description: Structured conclusions per §58.3. Individual fields are null when not applicable (e.g. no GIS restriction on the preferred point).

preferred_point.description: Lowest-risk applicable, allowed point. Null when recommendation_type='do_not_venture'. §59, §60

preferred_point_reason.description: Required when the tie-band rule selected a non-lowest-score point for PFZ/ecosystem advantage. §59.2

excluded_points.description: Points removed during hard-constraint selection, for audit/evidence. §59.1, §79

best_time_windows.description: Deterministically calculated per §63.1, ranked by lowest max score then length.

is_alternative_horizon.description: True if this window falls outside the originally requested window and is offered as an alternative. §63.1 step 5, §60

point_scores.description: All applicable points' Risk scores, returned exactly as received — never modified. §58.4, Rule 34
